summary: Frontend-only regression on /properties tap-to-flip. Verified 4 scenarios using Playwright with a mobile+touch context (is_mobile=True, has_touch=True) so that matchMedia('(hover: none)') returns true, and a normal desktop context for regression. All primary and secondary criteria pass.

test_results.TEST1_mobile_tap_to_flip: PASS - first tap on .flip-front adds 'is-flipped' class; URL stays on /properties (no navigation).
test_results.TEST2_mobile_view_property_navigation: PASS - tapping data-testid=property-view-<slug> after flip navigates to /properties/<slug>.
test_results.TEST3_mobile_flip_back_on_back_area_tap: PASS - tapping the back area (outside the CTA) removes 'is-flipped'; URL remains on /properties.
test_results.TEST4_desktop_regression_click_navigates: PASS - on desktop (hover supported), clicking .flip-front navigates directly to /properties/<slug>.

critical_code_review_comments: PropertyFlipCard.tsx implementation is clean: isTouch() gate on onFront prevents desktop hijack; back's onClick uses stopPropagation on the VIEW PROPERTY Link so CTA still navigates on touch. No issues found.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the 3 seeded prototype properties (chelsea, kensington, fulham).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile tap-to-flip on /properties works end-to-end. When testing, use a mobile+touch Playwright context (is_mobile=True, has_touch=True) so CSS '(hover:none)' matches; without it the tap-to-flip is intentionally bypassed. Use element_handle.click() rather than raw touchscreen.tap coordinates to reliably trigger the React onClick on Next.js <Link>.
